files.migration.md:
# Parser compatibility contract

Export parseLog(line), returning only {timestamp, level, message} or null for malformed/unsupported input. Legacy records split at the first two pipe characters: timestamp|LEVEL|message. Preserve the message remainder verbatim, including extra pipes and empty text; timestamp must be nonempty and the exact supported legacy uppercase levels are INFO, WARN, ERROR. Keep existing accepted legacy timestamps as strings; do not add date validation.

New format: a JSON object with string timestamp (nonempty), string level and string message (empty allowed). JSON levels may be lowercase or uppercase and normalize to uppercase. Supported normalized levels remain INFO, WARN, ERROR. Ignore extra object fields. Arrays, invalid JSON, missing fields, nonstring fields, unknown levels and nonstring input return null. Do not throw on malformed input. No external logging/network behavior.
